admin.description: Admin gates the admin-only screens in clients. The API does not enforce it.

cached.description: Cached is how many catalogue entries this search wrote locally.

truncated.description:
Truncated is true when the provider matched more than the single page that
was fetched. Clients must say so rather than presenting the page as the
complete answer.

upstream_total.description:
UpstreamTotal is how many entries the provider matched in total, which is
routinely far more than one page.

entries.description:
Entries is how many provider entries are cached locally and therefore
searchable without spending a provider request.

pages.description: Pages bounds the run. Omitted means marketdata.DefaultSeedPages.

sync_prices.description:
SyncPrices controls whether creation immediately backfills price history.
It defaults to true so existing clients keep the original behaviour. The
catalogue drawer sends false when adopting a batch: backfilling is a
synchronous paged provider fetch, so one full history sync per adopted
listing would stall the request and drain the provider request budget.

adoptable.description:
Adoptable is false when a row cannot become a listing, with AdoptableReason
explaining why, so clients can disable the row instead of failing on submit.

has_eod.description: HasEOD reports whether the provider holds end-of-day history for the symbol.

tracked.description: Tracked marks rows that are already listings rather than catalogue entries.

splitFactor.description:
SplitFactor is the share multiplier the instrument underwent on this date: 4
means one share became four. Ordinary days report 1, as do manually imported
rows that carry no corporate-action data.
